title: Final Fantasy XI Online PC Windows Video Game DISC 1 & 2 ONLY
descriptionText:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Final Fantasy Xi with this PC game set, featuring discs 1 and 2 only. Join the adventure with other players from around the world in this action-packed, role-playing game. With a multicolor landscape and engaging storyline, this game is sure to keep you entertained for hours.

Experience the thrill of battle and strategy as you navigate through the game's various challenges. This CD format game is compatible with English-speaking computers and is region-free. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with Final Fantasy Xi Online, brought to you by Square-Enix.
